says: In next/, a reserve fault met at the Project location is saved in the name's Process fault slot like a Process one, and resume then checks the pending charge against the Process recovery allowance, the wrong place's room; the saved fault does not say which location it was met at.
proof: QuotasSql.ts:533 recordFault saves a Project-located RecoveryReserveExhausted with writes or bytes set to its required room, in the same Fault shape protect saves for a Process one; resume at QuotasSql.ts:604 proposes that pending charge to the Process recovery machine only. The Process object's store cannot read the Project's account in its transaction, so checking the right room needs a new Project call, which is why the fix round left it.
cost: A person restart after a Project-located fault may be refused because the Process window is tight, or cleared while the Project window is still full, in which case the restart meets the fault again and the name stops again.
